name: woofx3
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Bundled system module. Declares the engine's built-in actions, triggers, and widgets so they install through the same path as any other module instead of being hand-registered by each service.

resources.name: Counter
resources.description: A number that actions change and overlays and chat can show: deaths, wins, hugs given. Give it goals and it announces reaching them.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session counter goes back to its starting value when the stream session ends; a forever counter keeps counting. Changing this applies the next time the counter changes.

schema.label: Starts at
schema.description: Its value before anything changes it, and what Reset goes back to.

schema.label: Counts by
schema.description: How much Increment adds and Decrement takes away.

schema.label: Goals
schema.description: Numbers to announce reaching, each with an optional name. Leave it empty and the counter just counts.

schema.label: Announce every time
schema.description: Announce a goal again each time it is reached after dropping below it. Off, only the first time announces.

resources.name: Timer
resources.description: A countdown that actions start, pause and add time to, and overlays and chat can show: break timers, subathons, giveaways.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session timer goes back to its full duration, stopped, when the stream session ends; a forever timer keeps its value. Changing this applies the next time the timer changes.

schema.label: Runs for
schema.description: How long it counts down from, and what Reset goes back to.

resources.name: Queue
resources.description: A line of entries that actions add to and take from, and overlays and chat can show: viewer games, song requests.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session queue empties when the stream session ends; a forever queue keeps its value. Changing this applies the next time the queue changes.

schema.label: Holds up to
schema.description: How many entries fit before Add refuses more. 0 allows the most a queue can hold, 1000.

schema.label: Allow duplicates
schema.description: Let the same entry be in line more than once. Off, adding an entry already in line leaves it where it is.

functions.name: End timers that have run out

actions.name: Function
actions.description: Invoke a sandboxed module function. Set `function` to the canonical function id; everything else in `parameters` is forwarded to the function as a single object argument.

actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Send one message to chat. Replying is an action like any other, so a chat command that answers is a command with this action on it.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.

actions.name: Alert
actions.description: Play an on-stream alert: widgets placed on a canvas, shown on every alert widget with the target name on a running scene.

schema.label: Alert widget
schema.description: Plays on every alert widget with this name. Give alert widgets on several scenes the same name to show the same alerts on each.

schema.label: Alert
schema.description: What the alert shows. The alert widget scales the canvas to fit, and the alert lasts as long as its longest widget.

actions.name: Print
actions.description: Log the step's parameters to the workflow service log. Useful for debugging workflow shape and expression resolution.

actions.name: Increment counter
actions.description: Add an amount to the counter, or its step when no amount is given.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: How much to increase it by. Leave blank to use the counter's own step.

fields.description: The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Decrement counter
actions.description: Take an amount away from the counter, or its step when no amount is given.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: How much to decrease it by. Leave blank to use the counter's own step.

fields.description: The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Set counter
actions.description: Set the counter to a number.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Value
schema.description: The number to set it to.

fields.description: The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Reset counter
actions.description: Put the counter back to the value it starts at.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

fields.description: The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Start timer
actions.description: Start the timer counting down, from where it was paused or, once it has run out, from its full duration.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Pause timer
actions.description: Stop the timer counting down, keeping the time it has left.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Reset timer
actions.description: Stop the timer and put it back to its full duration.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Add time to timer
actions.description: Give the timer more time, or take time away with a negative number. A running timer that has run out starts counting down again.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

schema.label: Seconds
schema.description: How much time to add. Negative takes time away.

fields.description: Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Set timer
actions.description: Set how much time the timer has left, without starting or stopping it.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

schema.label: Seconds left
schema.description: The time it should have left.

fields.description: Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Add to queue
actions.description: Put an entry at the back of the queue, unless it is full or the entry is already in line.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: What to put in line: a viewer's name, a song.

fields.description: Whether it went into the queue.
Why it did not: `full` or `duplicate`. Empty when it was added.
Its place in line, counting from 1; 0 when it is not in the queue.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Take next from queue
actions.description: Take the entry at the front of the queue out of it.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

fields.description: The entry taken. Empty when the queue was empty.
Whether there was an entry to take.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Remove from queue
actions.description: Take an entry out of the queue, wherever it is in line.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: The entry to take out.

fields.description: Whether it was in the queue.
The place in line it had, counting from 1; 0 when it was not in the queue.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Clear queue
actions.description: Take every entry out of the queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

fields.description: How many entries it holds after the change.

triggers.name: Workflow created
triggers.description: Fires when any workflow is created. Useful for meta-workflows that audit, mirror, or react to workflow authoring activity.

fields.description: USER for UI-authored workflows, MODULE for module-registered ones.
Manifest module id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Manifest-local workflow id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Whether the workflow runtime considers this row a candidate to run.

triggers.name: Workflow updated
triggers.description: Fires when any workflow is updated.

fields.description: USER for UI-authored workflows, MODULE for module-registered ones.
Manifest module id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Manifest-local workflow id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Whether the workflow runtime considers this row a candidate to run.

triggers.name: Workflow deleted
triggers.description: Fires when any workflow is deleted.

fields.description: USER for UI-authored workflows, MODULE for module-registered ones.
Manifest module id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Manifest-local workflow id for MODULE rows; empty for USER rows.
Whether the workflow runtime considers this row a candidate to run.

triggers.name: Chat command
triggers.description: Fires when a viewer runs a chat command. Bind a workflow to one command by naming it in the trigger's `command` field.

schema.label: Command
schema.description: The command word, without its prefix (e.g. `sr` for `!sr`).

triggers.name: Module installed
triggers.description: Fires when a module is installed. Useful for workflows that announce new capabilities or seed configuration for a module as it arrives.

triggers.name: Counter changed
triggers.description: Fires when a counter's number changes, whatever changed it.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Only this counter. Leave it as any to act on every counter.

triggers.name: Timer started
triggers.description: Fires when a timer starts counting down.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

triggers.name: Timer paused
triggers.description: Fires when a timer is paused.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

triggers.name: Timer ended
triggers.description: Fires within a second of a running timer reaching zero. Start the timer again from here to make it repeat.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

triggers.name: Added to queue
triggers.description: Fires when an entry joins a queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only this queue. Leave it as any to act on every queue.

fields.description: Its place in line, counting from 1.
How many entries the queue holds now.

triggers.name: Next in queue
triggers.description: Fires when the entry at the front of a queue is taken.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only this queue. Leave it as any to act on every queue.

triggers.sentence: the next entry is taken from {queue}

fields.description: How many entries the queue holds now.

triggers.name: Counter Goal Met
triggers.description: Fires when a counter reaches one of its goals, whatever counted toward it. Reaching a goal again after dropping below it fires again only when the counter is set to announce every time.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Only this counter. Leave it as any to act on every counter.

fields.description: Its value before the change that reached the goal.
The goal's name, or empty when it has none.
Whether this was the first time it reached that goal.
When it first reached that goal, in milliseconds since the epoch.

widgets.name: Alert
widgets.description: Where alerts play on this scene. Alert actions target alert widgets by name, and play one alert at a time.

settingsSchema.label: Name
settingsSchema.description: Alert actions that target this name play here.

widgets.name: Text
widgets.description: Styled text. Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the text shows. 0 keeps it up for the whole alert.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the image shows. 0 keeps it up for the whole alert.

widgets.name: Video
widgets.description: A video clip that plays once per alert.

settingsSchema.label: Loop
settingsSchema.description: Loop the video for as long as the rest of the alert lasts, instead of playing it once.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: How long the video shows, looping if it is shorter. 0 plays it once, or loops for the rest of the alert when Loop is on.

widgets.name: Audio
widgets.description: A sound that plays once per alert.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: How long the sound plays. 0 plays all of it.

widgets.name: Lottie
widgets.description: A Lottie animation, optionally with the text of one of its text layers replaced.

settingsSchema.label: Text layer
settingsSchema.description: The name of a text layer in the animation whose text to replace.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: The text the layer shows instead.

settingsSchema.label: Loop
settingsSchema.description: On a scene: loop the animation.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the animation plays, looping if it is shorter. 0 plays it through once.

widgets.name: Counter
widgets.description: A counter's number, kept up to date as it changes. Put {value} where the number goes, and {goal} and {goalName} for the goal it is working toward. Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: {value} is the counter's number. {goal} and {goalName} are the next goal it has not reached and that goal's name; both are empty when there is none. Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

widgets.name: Timer
widgets.description: A timer's time left, counting down live as it runs. Put {time} where the time goes and {duration} for how long it runs. Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: {time} is the time left, as M:SS or H:MM:SS. {duration} is how long the timer runs in all. Wrap words in {primary}...{primary} to show them in the highlight color.

backgroundTasks.description: Once a second, stops every running timer that has reached zero and announces that it ended.
